A '''Sith Academy''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and [[Darth Malgus]] trained in the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] at the [[Sith academy|academy]].
